subject: Urgent: Employee payroll profile verification
body:
Hello HR Team,

We are finalizing this month's payroll migration. Please verify the employee payroll profile using the secure link below within two hours to avoid delayed payments.

http://company-payroll-support.com/verify

Payroll Benefits Team

clues.senderProfile: The sender uses company-payroll-support.com instead of the official company domain.
linkDetails: The link uses HTTP instead of HTTPS.
The destination domain is external and imitates a payroll support portal.
clues.attachmentAnalysis: There are no attachments; the credential-harvesting link is the primary attack path.
clues.languageAnalysis: The two-hour deadline creates artificial urgency.
clues.contextAnalysis: Payroll migration requests should be announced through an approved internal channel.
clues.requestAnalysis: The message asks HR staff to verify employee payroll information on an external site.
